turns.doctor_question: Hello, I'm Dr. Smith. It's nice to meet you; could you tell me what brings you in to see me today?
turns.patient_response:
Nice to meet you, Dr. Smith. Well, I'm here because I just can't seem to keep myself together lately. Ever since my daughter left for basic training, I feel like I come home to a dead house, and it's really messing with me. 

It's getting bad. I'm sitting in my truck crying before my shifts start. At work, I'm missing steps on welding jobs I’ve done for years, and I've been snapping at the younger guys on the crew. And when I'm off the clock, I've just stopped going out on the water or working on my sculptures. I just don’t see the point right now. I need to figure out how to get my head back on straight.
